subject: Marketplace microcopy + co-sell readiness checklist
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@amazon.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>; Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace product page: microcopy + co-sell readiness

Hi Rachel / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick turn so far. We're close on the AWS product page but need a final pass on the microcopy and a short answers doc for the co-sell readiness checklist. Deliverables we need from Redwood to complete the listing and co-sell intake: 

- Short one-line product description (<=140 chars)
- 3 benefit bullets (20-40 chars each)
- Pricing SKUs & short explanation of usage tiers
- Curation tags for the AMI (ML inference, low-latency, quantized)
- A completed co-sell checklist (we'll accept a spreadsheet)

I've attached the draft page we pulled together and annotated where copy needs work. Also cc'd Oliver from Acme — he'll confirm the pricing mapping for the bundled offering on their side.

[Attachment: product-page_v2.docx (docx, 48KB)]

Can you send the copy + checklist by Wednesday so we can move to approval?

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Chen
Product Manager, AWS Marketplace
Amazon Web Services

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace product page: microcopy + co-sell readiness

Emily — thanks, got it. Attaching our initial pass on snippets and a checklist draft. High-level notes below; details are inline in the attached file (proposed_snippets.md).

- One-liner suggestion: "Redwood Inference — low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." (we kept it tight to hit marketplace character limits)
- Benefit bullets (proposed):
  • Production-grade latency at scale
  • Predictable cost controls & autoscaling policies
  • Unified API across hosted/dedicated/private
- Pricing SKUs: We propose three SKUs: pay-as-you-go (hosted inference), reserved-node (dedicated), private-deploy license. Oliver — can you confirm the effective monthly commit tiers?
- AMI tags: added the three suggested tags and a short technical blurb for the AMI description.
- Checklist: filled most rows but left procurement/legal contact fields blank — need your DocuSign link for the private offer paperwork.

Attachments: proposed_snippets.md, redwood_aws_listing_checklist.xlsx

Can Kimberly or Ben review the hero tone? If we're ok I'll push a trimmed version to the seller console.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_snippets.md (md, 4KB)]
[Attachment: redwood_aws_listing_checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace product page: microcopy + co-sell readiness

Thanks Rachel — quick edits inline. Main suggestions:

- Shorten the one-liner to: "Low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference — hosted, dedicated, private." (keeps focus on differentiators and fits the hero slot)
- Benefit bullets: swap order to lead with cost controls, then latency, then unified API (matches buyer priorities we've seen)
- Pricing SKUs: clarify that reserved-node includes burst capacity option and that private-deploy is license + annual support fee (we should avoid listing exact $ numbers in marketplace text)
- AMI blurb: add note about KMS/HSM integrations (customers ask this in onboarding)

I'll mark the final hero copy in the doc; Rachel — if you approve I'll load the hero + bullets into the seller console draft.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace & Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@amazon.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace product page: microcopy + co-sell readiness

Rachel / Kim — this looks good. Quick responses: 

- One-liner: "Low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference — hosted, dedicated, private." approved for hero.
- Pricing: AWS is ok with the SKU naming convention you proposed; we will surface tier examples in the private offer doc, not public listing.
- AMI tags & KMS note: included.
- DocuSign / private offer: use this PowerForm to start the private offer paperwork — https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?e=abc123
- Seller console link to submit draft: https://sellercentral.aws.amazon.com/offer/12345

Oliver confirmed the commit tiers on their side (he cc'd me) — looks aligned. If you can upload the final hero and bullets by EOD Thursday we'll schedule a co-sell intake review next week.

Emily

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>; Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@amazon.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acme.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace product page: microcopy + co-sell readiness

All — final tidy from me. I'll push the trimmed hero into the seller console and attach the checklist we agreed to. Next steps (internal):

1) Rachel — finalize the short description in the proposed_snippets.md and confirm the three benefit bullets are exactly as we want them on the listing.
2) Rachel / Kim — confirm AMI tags + the KMS line are present in the AMI description field.
3) Rachel — get Oliver's signed private-offer PowerForm completed and drop DocuSign link into the checklist.

I'll handle the seller console upload once you confirm the final copy. Attached: redwood_aws_listing_checklist-final.xlsx (updated).

Thanks — on track for next-week intake.

Ben Carter
Director, Partnerships & GTM Enablement
Redwood Inference
